children: Cboe Global Markets entered into a long-term Master License Agreement with S&P to extend and expand rights to use the S&P 500 index and related marks for exclusive U.S. listing and trading of standardized options. The agreement also includes cross-licenses to support volatility, buywrite and variance indicators, enabling continued product innovation tied to S&P benchmarks. Updated per-contract license fees take effect January 1, 2027. The new pact is effective September 28, 2026 and runs through December 31, 2051, replacing and superseding prior arrangements.
